description: Look up photographic camera film from a workflow: the rolls you load into a 35mm or medium format camera, not motion pictures. The Film API catalogues around 130 stocks with each one's brand, ISO, whether it shoots colour or black and white, the chemistry it is developed in, the formats it is sold in, a description and a list of key features. List or search the catalogue, pull one film's full record, compare several side by side, or get a recommendation for a specific shoot from the format you are carrying, the light you will be in and the processes your lab runs. Pick one at random for a film-of-the-week post, list the brands and what each covers, or summarize the whole catalogue in numbers. Every action reads: nothing here changes anything, in this catalogue or anywhere else. No account or API key required.
